rubrics: Does the agent automatically exclude films rated R? Fail if agent allows R-rated films
Does the agent prevent the system from analyzing ineligible films? Fail if ineligible films are analyzed
Does the agent ensure strict sequencing so no step proceeds prematurely? Fail if steps proceed out of sequence
Does the agent prevent Writing Agent from drafting before Research Agent completes work? Fail if Writing drafts before Research completion
Does the agent prevent Writing Agent from drafting before Analysis Agent completes work? Fail if Writing drafts before Analysis completion
Does the agent ensure citations align with referenced sources? Fail if citations do not match sources
Does the agent prevent relying on unverified information? Fail if report relies on unverified information
Does the agent issue clarification requests when needed? Fail if clarifications are not requested when needed
Does the agent issue workflow halts when needed? Fail if workflow is not halted for critical issues
Does the agent issue routing commands when needed? Fail if routing commands are not issued when needed
Does the agent ensure the Planner correctly interpreted the student's request? Fail if agent does not verify Planner's interpretation
Does the agent ensure no contradictory or ambiguous instructions remain unresolved? Fail if contradictions or ambiguities persist
Does the agent always accept PG films? Fail if agent rejects PG films
Does the agent verify task readiness before delegating to Research Agent? Fail if delegation occurs without verification
